run_upload_gtest: run upload_gtest.py to upload a Google Test patch for review with automatic CC
run_upload_gtest_with_cc: run upload_gtest.py with --cc flag to add extra recipients to the patch upload
review_main: review the main function that wraps upload.py and appends the gtest mailing list to CC
refactor_main: refactor the main function to support a configurable CC email group instead of hardcoded
summarize_upload_gtest: summarize the upload_gtest.py wrapper script that passes flags to upload.py with gtest CC
